comparison.objective: Open a ZIF latch, insert a flexible sensor cable, and close the latch while keeping the cable seated.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-strip pickup, fine insertion, bimanual hold-and-latch coordination, and electronics assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Cable fully seated with latch opened before insertion and closed afterward; the available body gives no complete numeric pose or hold thresholds.
comparison.reason: This is connector insertion and latching, whereas the candidate tests tool-mediated controlled fracture and fragment recovery. Shared fine alignment and bimanual holding are generic primitives only.
